gate: R1-002 P0 — freeze public DeepSeek Adapter API

cases.requirement: R1-001 governance closure exact head is dual-green before R1-002 repository work begins.
PR #3 remains Open/Draft/unmerged and R1-003+, M5-003+, registry publish and merge remain unauthorized.
createDshRc5Adapter is importable from the package root without a deep src/binding import.
An external TypeScript consumer can construct the Adapter using only package-root imports plus the supported Harness Context type.
Public DshRc5AdapterOptions requires a callable digest(value: unknown): string.
Invalid locally-known public options fail with INVALID_ADAPTER_OPTIONS before any Adapter-owned Harness registration.
Optional onObservationFailure remains diagnostic-only and cannot influence policy authorization.
Deterministic now/clock injection is not part of the frozen public Alpha options or package-root public contract.
DshRc5Adapter is a dedicated curated public interface and does not publicly extend broad M2 HarnessRuntimeAdapter.
The rc5 public Adapter type does not expose filesystem or subprocess provider ports.
Public metadata includes adapterName, adapterVersion, harnessVersion, harnessCommit and features.
observe is public and returns a disposable/drainable observation subscription.
observeAudit is public and preserves the accepted Adapter-owned audit-egress boundary.
registerToolPolicy is public and preserves handler-failure fail-closed DENY semantics.
registerMonotonicToolGuard is public for the rc5 supported seam and preserves monotonic hard-veto semantics.
registerTurnStopping is public and returns an independently disposable registration.
requestApproval is public and preserves absent-service UNAVAILABLE and existing approval outcome mappings.
steerCompletion is public and preserves existing retry-budget and live-turn checks.
DshRc5Adapter exposes aggregate asynchronous dispose().
Adapter dispose is idempotent and concurrent dispose calls share one teardown completion.
Adapter dispose detaches every Adapter-owned root Harness listener registered during construction.
Adapter dispose cascades to still-live observation/audit/policy/guard/turn-stopping child resources created through that Adapter.
Adapter dispose waits for events already accepted by owned observation/audit dispatchers to settle before completion.
Adapter dispose does not dispose the caller-owned Harness/Cordis Context, agents, services or independent listeners.
Child handles remain safe to dispose again after aggregate Adapter disposal; observation drain remains usable for settled work.
New observe/observeAudit/register operations after disposal begins fail with DshAdapterError code ADAPTER_DISPOSED before touching Harness.
requestApproval and steerCompletion after disposal begins fail with ADAPTER_DISPOSED before initiating a new Harness action.
A construction failure after partial Harness registration rolls back every registration created by that construction attempt.
Failed construction returns no live Adapter handle and leaves no Adapter-owned policy/audit/observation/classification listener behind.
DshAdapterError and lifecycle option/disposed error codes are importable from the public root contract.
Types required by public Adapter methods are available from the package root; consumers do not need source-conformance or internal deep imports.
Internal normalization/dispatcher/provider/replay/source-conformance/test helpers and package-stage markers are not frozen as Alpha semver commitments.
Public root contract tests compile against exact supported rc5 types without importing package-private binding or test modules.
Public API and dispose semantics do not claim process isolation, arbitrary plugin sandboxing, complete host-effect mediation or external-effect rollback.
Implementation and final review remain source/runtime conformance tested against exact 0.1.0-rc.5 commit 47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a.
Protocol-first delta contains only Spec 0056, this corpus and CURRENT; no production/test/package metadata/R1-003+ change occurs before exact-head dual-green.
